title: Exercise 1 – ABC
text: ABC's share price on 1 October 2021 was EUR 350.40. On 9 May 2022 the firm paid a dividend of EUR 4 per share; the share price on this day was EUR 340.40. On 31 October 2022 the share price was EUR 380.20.

title: Exercise 2 – A two-stock portfolio
text: You invest EUR 2,000 in stock A and EUR 1,000 in stock B. Their returns have a correlation of 0.4.

title: Exercise 3 – Sustainable and unsustainable stocks
text: Suppose you group all stocks in the world into two mutually exclusive portfolios based on their sustainability rating. The two portfolios have equal total value and a correlation of 0.6. The risk-free rate is 3%.

title: Exercise 4 – Should you add ESCP Corporation?
text: You currently invest only in an ETF that tracks the market portfolio. The ETF and the market have an expected return of 14% with a volatility of 20%. The risk-free rate is 2%. Your broker suggests adding ESCP Corporation: expected return 5%, volatility 10%, correlation of zero with the ETF and the market.

title: Exercise 5 – Musical instruments
text: You estimate the equity beta of a private firm that manufactures musical instruments, using publicly traded firms in the same industry. The private firm has a debt-to-equity ratio of 1. No firm pays corporate tax, and all debt betas are zero.

title: Exercise 6 – Zeta and Omicron
text: Zeta Industries and Omicron Technology have identical assets that generate identical cash flows. Zeta is all-equity financed with 10 million shares trading at EUR 22. Omicron has 20 million shares and EUR 60 million of debt. Assume perfect capital markets.
